headline: "IN ABRUZZO LIFE IS INCREASINGLY EXPENSIVE FOR YOUNG PEOPLE", SI-UGS STUDY, "TOO MANY LIVING AT HOME WITH PARENTS"
summary: A SI-UGS study says living as a young person in Abruzzo costs more than three years ago. Student room rents in Teramo rose from 200 to 300 euros a month, up 50% since 2023.
why: Housing and transport costs for young workers and students affect household spending and regional labour supply. Rising rents also feed into local property and consumer demand.
